title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must not have the avahi package installed.
check_content:
Verify that the avahi package is not installed with the following command:

$ dnf list –installed avahi

Error: No matching Packages to list

If the "avahi" package is installed, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove the avahi package with the following command:

$ dnf remove avahi
VulnDiscussion: The avahi package provides the zeroconf capability to discover remote services such as printers and announce itself as a service for sharing files and devices.
